from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-0bc14b1d.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, c in points if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    mr, mc = markers[0]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                distance = max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc))
                out[r][c] = 4 if distance % 2 == 1 else 2
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',program_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo_in=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for c in range(3,12): demo_in[2][c]=3; demo_in[10][c]=3
for r in range(2,11): demo_in[r][3]=3; demo_in[r][11]=3
demo_in[6][7]=3
